risk_summary: The disclosure is generally well quantified and reconciles year-over-year operating and cash-flow changes, but it highlights weakening bookings, a declining backlog, dependence on defense-program timing, and lower product yields. Conditional language around order declines and potential downsizing limits the specificity of forward-looking risk assessment. Current profitability and operating cash flow provide some offset, although the excerpt is mixed with boilerplate audit and financial-statement material.
